title: Qt: Replace text codec ranking heuristics with category-tagged struct
description:
The regex-based ranking assigned sort rank by alphabetical range
(e.g. anything before "IBM" got rank 1), which grouped unrelated
scripts like Armenian, Chinese, and Georgian into the same sort
bucket. Replace with a struct array where each encoding carries its
category directly in the data, making menu ordering explicit and
trivial to maintain.

Fixup: 89b502a6

AI-Assisted: yes (Kiro)

notes.body: enabled automatic add to merge train when checks pass
changed title from Qt: Replace codec ranking heuristics with category-tagged struct to Qt: Replace text codec ranking heuristics with category-tagged struct
("Codec", in Wireshark, could refer either to character-encoding codecs or to audio/video codecs; I changed the merge request title to reflect that this is a change for the former.)
